entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I cannot even begin to fathom what[n]Madarame's Treasure may be...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Either way, we'll steal it for sure.[n]Oh, and you all did great today!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The cognitive door is closed. Should we[n]head back?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We'll need to regroup back in the real[n]world for now.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right, Joker. Let's retreat!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Where are you going, Joker?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Haven't we checked those cells enough?[n]Let's look further inside the castle next.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We'll have to pass through the entrance[n]hall to get there... but wasn't the door[n]locked?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It'll be impossible unless we can find[n]another route to the first floor of that[n]hall.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: C'mon, we came all this way. Let's at least[n]try checkin' around a little more first.
